def seat_cake(name, loc, s=1.0):
    root = empty(name, loc)
    box(name + '_b', (1.4, 1.4, 0.5), (0, 0, 0.25), mat('cake_pink', hexc('#f09ac2'), 0.5), 0.1, parent=root)
    box(name + '_k', (1.4, 0.3, 1.0), (0, 0.55, 0.9), mat('cake_pink', hexc('#f09ac2'), 0.5), 0.1, parent=root)
    sphere(name + '_c', 0.16, (0, -0.2, 0.62), mat('cherry', hexc('#d8241e'), 0.3), parent=root, seg=10)
    root.scale = (s, s, s)
    return root
